page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine equipped with a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, it features 8 vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, coupled with 32 GB of system RAM to provide a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation. The processor includes 35 MB of L3 cache along with AVX, AVX-512F, and AES instruction support. Hardware accelerators are not present, and the instance provisions zero local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for file systems and data persistence. Network interfaces provide a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate modest computational throughput reflecting its mature processor architecture. The instance achieved a single-core Geekbench score of 935.0 and a multi-core score of 3539.0, accompanied by a PassMark CPU score of 6968.94. Memory performance tests showed uncached write speeds reaching 34.64 GB/sec, while uncached read bandwidth recorded 38.97 GB/sec. Application testing yielded 5.91 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and 4.37 GB/sec in static web throughput. Single-threaded gzip compression measured 19.05 GB/sec, and inference testing on small 135M language models delivered 98.99 text generation tokens per second.

From an infrastructure profile standpoint, the server provides stable and predictable baseline compute due to dedicated physical core mapping, preventing virtual resource contention. The trade-off lies in lower per-core compute output compared to newer processor architectures and the complete absence of local NVMe storage. The instance configuration is balanced for general business systems, staging environments, distributed application components, and moderate web application serving that do not demand heavy I/O throughput or modern machine learning acceleration.

The instance provides 35 MB of L3 cache, AVX-512 instruction support, and a baseline network throughput of 4 Gbps. It includes no integrated local storage or hardware GPU accelerators, necessitating external block storage for persistent data. Performance benchmarks indicate modest single-thread and multi-core capabilities, registering a PassMark CPU score of 6968.94 and Geekbench multi-core rating of 3539.0. Memory writes reach 34.64 GB/sec, while Redis throughput averages 5.91 million operations per second. With its balanced 1:4 processor-to-memory allocation, ecs.g5ne.2xlarge functions as a predictable environment for moderate web application hosting, testing environments, and standard enterprise backend services.
